name: Frame Guard
description: SubFPS: runs the game update at a fixed rate independent of the drawn frame rate, plus update-path optimizations and a self-verifying batch draw fast path.

subfps-mode.name: SubFPS mode
subfps-mode.description: In levels, runs the game update exactly 'SubFPS' times per second on a precise clock with a constant time step, and draws the screen only at Display Hz. This is NOT a physics or TPS change: GD's physics stays at 240 steps/s and its code is not touched. Keeps update timing perfectly even so Click-Between-Frames behaves the same at any refresh rate. Turns VSync off.

subfps.name: SubFPS
subfps.description: Game updates per second in SubFPS mode. 240 matches the physics rate; use a multiple of 240. Above 240 only keeps the shown state and input handling fresher, it does not make physics finer. The loop tops out around 20000-40000 updates/s, so higher values just mean as fast as possible (high CPU use). 1000-4000 is a sensible range.

show-subfps.name: Show SubFPS counter
show-subfps.description: Shows the executed update rate as 'N SubFPS' in the top-right corner of a level. The game's own FPS counter only counts presented frames.

display-hz.name: Display Hz
display-hz.description: Draw rate in SubFPS mode. 0 = auto-detect the primary monitor's refresh rate.

menu-fps.name: Menu FPS cap
menu-fps.description: FPS cap outside levels (lobby, menus) while SubFPS mode is on. 0 = very high.

lean-update.name: Lean update ticks
lean-update.description: SubFPS mode only. Updates that present no frame skip the whole draw pipeline and the progress bar refresh and run only the game update. Physics is not touched.

fast-batch.name: Batch fast path (recommended)
fast-batch.description: Skips redundant per-frame work for sprites that did not change, which helps in levels with many objects. Safe to leave on: it checks itself while running and turns itself off for the session if the check fails. Does not change gameplay or physics.

debug-log.name: Debug log (for bug reports)
debug-log.description: Writes FPS and performance info to the Geode log every 2 seconds. Leave off unless you are asked to send a log.
